source_page: Statement of Audited Standalone Financial Results FY26
extraction_notes: ebitda field uses the filing's own 'Operating Profit (PBIDT)' line directly. Exceptional items include VRS expense, forex loss, and stamp duty from the Cavendish Industries amalgamation per the filing's notes — this is a real corporate-action effect, not noise. Figures are restated to reflect the CIL amalgamation (effective Dec 22, 2025); prior-year comparatives in the source are also restated, so YoY comparisons using this record are on a like-for-like basis per the filing.
